description:
Find diseases associated with a specific phenotype (reverse search).
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table disease_phenotype — one record = one (disease, HPO phenotype) association with its evidence records.
Key: disease, phenotype.
Arguments: phenotype_id accepts hpo (resolved; unknown -> error); limit counts diseases, not rows.
Results: ranked by disease asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.disease` counts diseases; `_vbt.grains.phenotype` counts phenotypes.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. HPO disease-phenotype annotations integrated by OT 25.09; negated (NOT) evidence is a negative finding, not support.

evidence_type.description: Values of evidence[].evidenceType (see mcp__data__vocab). IEA: inferred from electronic annotation; PCS: published clinical study; TAS: traceable author statement; ICE: individual clinical experience.

include_negated.description: Include negative findings (evidence that the relation does NOT hold), which are excluded by default; their number is disclosed.

phenotype_id.description: Accepts hpo; resolved to one hpo (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
